name: private-repo
description: Internal OmniNode plugin marketplace. Private counterpart of the public agent plugin marketplace: ships the omni plugin, which carries the internal process skills, and the onex-overlays plugin, which carries the contract overlays the public onex skills read.

plugins.name: omni
plugins.description: Internal OmniNode process skills (lane briefs, ticket creation, PR landing, merge drains, CI triage, release cuts, session resume, friction recording, ledger writes/catchup/messaging, cited questions to the planning corpus and to the work ledger, and the check for who is waiting on the operator for a reply), invoked as /omni:<skill>. Skills only: hooks stay in the public plugin.

plugins.name: onex-overlays
plugins.description: Contract overlays for the public onex plugin's split skills (weekly_review, session_preflight, plans_board_refresh, board_readback, comment_sweep, overseer_verify_tick, lane_dispatch): the organization-specific half that the public skills refuse to run without. Data only: no skills, no hooks.
